long_biography.plain_text:
In the early 1990s, Mark S. Kulstad represented Landmark Realty on an Alaska state task force. He later acted for property owners in environmental matters, corresponding with regulators and other responsible parties over a contaminated drilling site. That work shows a sustained background in land and property management.

Kulstad subsequently moved into Seward's visitor economy. He and Mary Kulstad ran the community's century-old downtown hotel, while a separate company connected him to regional tourism in Prince William Sound. The hotel entered a new hospitality management portfolio in 2022. Kulstad's later commercial focus has remained private.
